name: First Comes Love
source:
The person you love is back in town, and it's time to unpack a drunken promise from your college years...

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/First_Comes_Love]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
你深愛的人回到了鎮上。大學時你們酒醉之下許的那個承諾……也該好好說清楚了。

［取自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/First_Comes_Love]Choices Wikia[/url]］
